mnemonic_bits.note: NewMnemonic reads each 11-bit word index straight out of entropy||sha256(entropy)[0] with shifts (one 24-bit window per word) instead of building a big.Int, appending the checksum one bit at a time with Mul and Or, and dividing by 2048 per word.

bytearray_bits.note: MnemonicToByteArray packs the 11-bit indexes into the right-aligned big-endian byte value directly and checks the checksum against the top bits of the first SHA-256 byte, instead of big.Int Mul/Add per word, Exp and DivMod, and three padding copies. Results and error messages (including the first unknown word and the checksum byte position) are unchanged.
